rules.name: family safety card
rules.dm:
Your family safety card 🛡️
WhatsApp > Settings:
1. Privacy > Calls > Silence unknown callers ON
2. Privacy > Advanced > Protect IP address in calls ON
3. Account > Two-step verification > set a PIN
4. Family group > tap its name > Advanced chat privacy ON
Panic call asking for money, even in a voice you know? Ask your family code word. No word = hang up, call back on the saved number.
"Power cut tonight, call this officer" SMS = scam. Never install AnyDesk for anyone.
Money lost? Call 1930 right away.
Send this to your family group 🙏

rules.name: 10 ChatGPT codes
rules.dm:
10 ChatGPT "codes" that actually work (plain words, any AI):
1. Devil's advocate: [your idea]
2. Explain like I'm 10, with a daily-life example: [topic]
3. Quiz me on [topic], 5 questions, one at a time
4. Answer in 3 lines: [question]
5. Make this a table: [messy info]
6. Give me 3 really different options: [task]
7. What am I missing? List the risks: [plan]
8. Check this and explain each fix: [your text]
9. Rewrite this, simple and polite: [message]
10. Ask me questions first, then answer: [problem]
Save your favourites in Settings > Personalization > Custom instructions.
